_comment: Single source of truth for prices and package terms. The agency site, the Stripe setup script, the invoice tool and the documents all read from this. After editing, run: node scripts/sync-shared.mjs

starter.name: Starter Website
starter.summary: A one-page site with everything a guest looks for: the menu, hours, location, and one-tap links to call, get directions, order or reserve.
starter.typicalLaunch: about one to two weeks after we have your materials
includes: One-page, mobile-first website built with your name, logo and colors
Your full menu as real text with prices, organized by section (never a PDF)
Hours, address, a tap-to-call number and a Get Directions link
Buttons that open the online ordering and reservation systems you already use
An 'Open now' indicator and holiday hours
Search-engine basics: page titles, descriptions, and restaurant details in the format Google reads
Connection to your own domain name and launch
Two rounds of revisions and a 14-day fix window after launch

premium.name: Premium Website
premium.summary: A multi-page site for restaurants with more to say: a dedicated menu page, photo gallery, your story, a catering page and a contact form.
premium.typicalLaunch: about two weeks after we have your materials
includes: Everything in Starter
Separate pages: Home, Menu, Gallery, Our Story, Catering and Contact
Menu page with jump-to-section navigation and dietary labels
Photo gallery with a full-screen viewer
Contact form with spam protection, delivered to your inbox
Announcement bar for specials and holiday hours
Frequently-asked-questions section
Two rounds of revisions and a 14-day fix window after launch

catering.name: Catering Inquiry Automation
catering.summary: A catering request form that records every inquiry in a spreadsheet you own, emails you the details at once, and sends the customer a note that the request arrived. It never confirms a booking, a price or a date for you.
includes: Catering request form: date, headcount, type of service, budget and notes
Every request saved to a Google Sheet that belongs to you
An email to you with all the details the moment a request comes in
An automatic note to the customer saying the request arrived (it confirms nothing)
Setup in your own Google account, testing, and a 15-minute walkthrough
catering.requires: Works with either website package. Needs a Google account that belongs to the restaurant.

maintenance.name: Monthly Website Maintenance
maintenance.summary: Hosting, updates and small changes handled for you, month to month.
includes: Hosting on our managed account, with the security certificate (https)
Up to 60 minutes of small changes each month: menu items, prices, hours, photos, announcements
Software and security updates
Monitoring that the site and its forms are working
A reply within two business days (one business day if the site is down)
Month to month. Cancel any time with 30 days' notice, and we hand over your site files

notIncluded: The yearly fee for your domain name (about $12 to $20, paid by you to the registrar, in your name)
Professional photography or logo design (we work with what you have, and the site is designed to look finished without photos)
The online ordering or reservation system itself (we link to the one you use)
Paid advertising, social media management or ongoing SEO campaigns
